positions.title: AI/ML Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and deployed an enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform using Python, FastAPI, Neo4j, and AWS, enabling secure, context-aware knowledge retrieval across internal engineering documentation and reducing information lookup time by 35%.
Engineered a graph-based RAG platform using Neo4j, PySpark, Kafka, and AWS, enabling secure real-time enterprise knowledge retrieval while reducing query latency by 25% and unauthorized data exposure by 30%.
Integrated transformer-based anomaly detection models using Python, Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, and AWS, partnering with security engineering teams to improve AI-driven threat detection accuracy by 18%.
Automated production ML deployments using Git, AWS, and CI/CD, streamlining model versioning, validation, and release processes to shorten deployment cycles by 20% while improving release reliability.
Monitored and optimized production AI model performance using inference logs, operational metrics, and user feedback, improving prediction consistency, model stability, and overall system reliability.

positions.title: Data Engineer - AI/ML Systems
positions.description:
Designed scalable ETL pipelines using PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, Hive, and AWS to process high-volume financial and healthcare datasets, increasing data throughput by 30% while supporting reliable downstream analytics.
Modernized legacy enterprise services by migrating monolithic APIs to a microservices architecture using FastAPI, Express.js, and Python, reducing API response time by 35% and improving application scalability.
Developed a Hospital Management System using Java, SQL, and PostgreSQL, automating patient registration, appointment scheduling, billing, and medical record management to reduce administrative effort by 40%.
Built reusable data ingestion and transformation frameworks using Python, PySpark, Kafka, and SQL, automating high-volume data processing and reducing manual processing effort by 35%.
Integrated MongoDB, Cassandra, and AWS data services into enterprise analytics platforms, enabling near real-time reporting and reducing report generation time by 45% for business stakeholders.
Improved enterprise data quality by implementing standardized validation, reconciliation, and transformation logic across PySpark-based ETL workflows, decreasing data inconsistencies by 20% and increasing reporting accuracy.
Deployed production-ready data engineering solutions through Git, CI/CD, and automated deployment pipelines, shortening release cycles by 25% while improving deployment consistency across multiple client engagements.
